title: Magnite CTV Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Magnite CTV (SpringServe) Publisher OpenRTB Connect adapter

seatCode.description: Magnite CTV seat code, used as the endpoint subdomain

region.description: Regional endpoint to send requests to (defaults to eu-west-1)

tagid.description: Value for imp.tagid, used for supply routing within the seat
